faq.question: What kinds of SEO projects do you take?
faq.answer: I focus on technical SEO, programmatic SEO at scale, and entity-based optimization for SaaS, hosting, and tech companies. Projects typically include comprehensive technical audits, Core Web Vitals optimization, structured data implementation, programmatic content strategies, and knowledge graph development. Recent projects achieved 247% organic traffic growth and top-3 rankings for 150+ competitive keywords. I provide measurable outcomes with full documentation and code access when applicable. Minimum project size is typically $15K for comprehensive audits, with ongoing retainers available.

faq.question: Which tech stacks do you prefer for web applications?
faq.answer: My primary stacks are Laravel (PHP) for robust backends with extensive ecosystem support, Node.js for real-time applications and microservices, and Python for data processing and automation. I deploy on Linux environments (Ubuntu/Debian) with KVM virtualization and Docker containerization. For APIs, I build both RESTful and GraphQL architectures depending on client needs. Recent projects include microservices handling 10M+ requests/day with sub-50ms response times, and KVM automation managing 1,200+ VMs with 99.98% uptime.

faq.question: How do you approach algorithmic trading research?
faq.answer: All research follows rigorous scientific methodology: data quality validation, walk-forward analysis, out-of-sample testing, and Monte Carlo simulations. I focus on systematic, rule-based strategies with clear risk management frameworks. My backtesting engine accounts for transaction costs, slippage, market impact, and realistic order execution. Recent frameworks achieved Sharpe ratios of 2.34 with max drawdowns under 10% over 7-year backtest periods. All work is for research purposes only—I don't provide financial advice, manage funds, or guarantee future performance. Full methodology documentation and reproducible code provided.

faq.question: Do you offer blockchain audits or only development?
faq.answer: I offer smart contract development, security reviews, and validator infrastructure setup. For security, I conduct thorough code reviews using industry-standard tools (Slither, Mythril, MythX) combined with manual analysis and attack vector testing. Recent projects include a DeFi lending protocol securing $4.2M+ TVL with 100% security score. However, for production DeFi protocols handling significant TVL, I recommend supplementing my review with specialized audit firms like Trail of Bits or OpenZeppelin. I'm best suited for development, architecture consulting, validator operations, and infrastructure work in the blockchain space.

faq.question: How can we verify your results and expertise?
faq.answer: All case studies link to verifiable data: GitHub repositories with 2,400+ total stars for code quality review, published articles on Medium detailing methodologies with reproducible steps, and anonymized analytics screenshots for client outcomes. My open-source projects (seo-performance-analyzer, quant-backtest-engine, blockchain-validator-suite) demonstrate real-world implementations. You can review independent testimonials from CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and technical leaders at CloudHost Pro, FinTech Solutions, and other firms. References available upon request. I maintain transparency through detailed documentation, technical blog posts, and active open-source contributions.

faq.question: What's your availability and typical engagement model?
faq.answer: I currently take on 2-3 concurrent projects with a mix of fixed-scope and retainer arrangements. Fixed-scope projects (audits, migrations, implementations) range from 4-12 weeks. Retainers are available for ongoing SEO optimization, infrastructure management, or development work, starting at $8K/month. I'm based in the US (PST timezone) and typically work with startups to mid-market companies. Initial consultation calls are free—we'll discuss your needs, technical challenges, and determine if there's a good fit. Contact me at alex.rivera@example.com to schedule.
